dataflows.name: Retail Trade
dataflows.description: CEASED - Dataset: RT. This dataset has been discontinued. Estimates of the value of turnover of retail trade for Australian businesses classified by industry, and by state and territory. Unit of measure: AUD/Percent. Geographic coverage: Australia/State. Catalogue number: 8501.0
